Additionally, Sorafenib is associated with Mood Alteration Nos, which is linked to Rimonabant, another compound that binds to Cyp2d6. These findings suggest that Sorafenib may exert its effects on Cyp2d6 through different pathways, possibly by modulating the activity of compounds that interact with the enzyme.
